title: The Honeycomb Window
youtube_title: The Honeycomb Window | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Wonder grows when you look without grabbing.
summary: At a garden path after a gentle rain, Bibi finds a honeycomb held to the window, not broken. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Bibi shows Ugo how to look without disturbing it. Mama looks too, and they leave it where it is.
